Start the service first; the addresses it can be reached at will be listed here.
Tad.NoLan: 没有检测到可用的局域网地址。请确认这台机器已连上网络（或已开启 Wi-Fi / 网线）。
No usable LAN address was detected. Make sure this machine is on a network (Wi-Fi or cable).
Tad.NoPublic: 没取到公网 IP：可能这台机器没有公网出口，或者请求被网络 / 代理拦截了。下面这个内网地址只能在同一个 Wi-Fi 下访问。
Could not get a public IP: this machine may have no public route, or the request was blocked by the network or a proxy. The intranet address below only works on the same Wi-Fi.
Tad.BrowserFail.Title: 打不开浏览器

Normal mode · port {0} · only this computer can open it
Tad.Subtitle.Lan: 局域网 · 端口 {0} · 手机连同一个 Wi-Fi 后扫码
LAN · port {0} · scan the code from a phone on the same Wi-Fi
Tad.Subtitle.Wan: 互联网 · 端口 {0} · 手机扫码（任何网络）
Internet · port {0} · scan the code from a phone on any network
Tad.Note.Lan: 手机、平板与这台电脑连同一个 Wi-Fi 就能扫码打开；扫不开时先确认防火墙放行了这个端口。
A phone or tablet on the same Wi-Fi can open it by scanning the code; if that fails, check that the firewall allows this port.
Tad.Note.Wan: 公网访问要先在路由器上把 {0} 端口映射到这台机器（或走反向代理）；这里显示的是本机出口地址，映射没做好的话外网仍然连不上。
Public access needs port {0} forwarded to this machine on the router (or a reverse proxy); this is the machine's outbound address, so without the mapping outside devices still cannot connect.
Tad.Note.Normal: 普通模式用这台电脑的浏览器打开酒馆。要让手机、平板也能打开，把启动模式切成「服务器模式」并选「局域网」。
Normal mode opens the tavern in this computer's browser. To let phones and tablets in, switch the launch mode to Server and pick LAN.
Tad.Note.NormalWithLan: 当前配置里开着「局域网访问」，同一 Wi-Fi 的设备其实也能连上这个端口。
LAN access is currently enabled, so devices on the same Wi-Fi can already reach this port.
